name: What is door casing and why is it important?

mainEntity.name: What is door casing and why is it important?

acceptedAnswer.text: Door casing, also known as trim or architrave, is the decorative molding that surrounds a door frame. Beyond its aesthetic appeal, it serves a functional purpose by covering the gap between the door frame and the wall, providing a finished look and protecting the edges of the wall from damage. It contributes significantly to the overall architectural style and insulation of a room, preventing drafts and improving energy efficiency by sealing gaps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Door casing is the decorative trim around a door frame, covering gaps and protecting walls. It adds aesthetic value and improves insulation.
